description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the TCA6424A GPIO expander, including register access, interrupt handling, and device initialization.

methods.name: read_port_regs
methods.description: Reads a block of 3 registers from the TCA6424A device and caches the result.

methods.name: write_port_regs
methods.description: Writes a block of 3 registers to the TCA6424A device.

methods.name: update_input_regs
methods.description: Updates the input register cache from the device.

methods.name: update_output_regs
methods.description: Updates the output register cache and writes to the device.

methods.name: tca6424a_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles GPIO interrupt triggered by the TCA6424A device.

methods.name: tca6424a_work_handler
methods.description: Work handler for processing TCA6424A interrupts.

methods.name: tca6424a_int_gpio_handler
methods.description: GPIO callback for TCA6424A interrupt pin.

methods.name: tca6424a_setup_pin
methods.description: Configures a specific pin as input or output.

methods.name: tca6424a_pin_config
methods.description: Configures a pin with specific flags.

methods.name: tca6424a_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets port bits according to mask and value.

methods.name: tca6424a_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific bits in port output.

methods.name: tca6424a_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific bits in port output.

methods.name: tca6424a_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specific bits in port output.

methods.name: tca6424a_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt triggering for a pin.

methods.name: tca6424a_init
methods.description: Initializes the TCA6424A device, configures GPIOs, resets device, and sets initial register states.
